name: OlmoEarth v1
title: OlmoEarth: Stable Latent Image Modeling for Multimodal Earth Observation
scope: Multimodal, spatio-temporal Earth observation foundation-model family using stable latent image modeling.
input_modality: Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1, and Landsat observations; six derived maps are used as pretraining targets.
architecture: Encoder-decoder Vision Transformer trained with masked image modeling and latent contrastive objectives.
downstream_tasks: Embeddings evaluated on 24 tasks; full fine-tuning reported on 29 tasks across classification, segmentation, regression, and mapping applications.
training_scale: 285,288 global 2.56 km × 2.56 km pretraining samples; Nano, Tiny, Base, and Large variants.
openness_text: Open source code, training data, and pre-trained weights are reported in the primary paper.
notes: Curated from the primary paper and official repository. OlmoEarth v1 is a multimodal masked-modeling encoder family, not an any-to-any generalist model.
entry_type_reason: Primary paper describes a reusable multimodal Earth observation foundation model with public code and reported weights.

name: OlmoEarth v1.2
title: OlmoEarth v1.2: A more efficient family of OlmoEarth models
scope: Latest efficiency-improved OlmoEarth family with lower training and inference cost while maintaining overall downstream performance.
input_modality: Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1, and Landsat observations; multimodal and multitemporal inputs.
architecture: Encoder-decoder Vision Transformer with masked image modeling, one band-set per modality, random band dropout, updated masking/loss, nonlinear projection, and RoPE.
downstream_tasks: Average-rank comparison across 13 embedding tasks; the report also provides a broader table of modality/task evaluation configurations.
training_scale: Same training data as v1; reports a 3.0× reduction in Base-model training GPU hours and 2.9× fewer MACs for Sentinel-2 inference.
openness_text: Open training code and released Nano, Tiny, Small, and Base weights.
fm_strength: Latest versioned primary-source curated EO foundation model
notes: Replaces the older v1.1 atlas row. The official repository now lists v1.2 as the latest family and recommends it as a drop-in replacement for v1.
entry_type_reason: Official primary-source release of the OlmoEarth model family.
